解答 由极坐标方程可得参数方程 $\left\{\begin{array}{l}x=a\theta\cos\theta\\y=a\theta\sin\theta\end{array}\right.$ 两边同时对 $\theta$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{d\theta}=a\cos\theta-a\theta\sin\theta,\quad \frac{dy}{d\theta}=a\sin\theta+a\theta\cos\theta,$$

可得 $\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/d\theta}{dx/d\theta}=\frac{a(\theta\cos\theta+\sin\theta)}{a(\cos\theta-\theta\sin\theta)}=\frac{\theta+\tan\theta}{1-\theta\tan\theta}.$
